about.description: AMZNX is a single-stock perpetual listed on Kraken, tracking Amazon.com, Inc., margined and cash-settled in USD. Traders get synthetic price exposure only — no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 1h. Up to 20× leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
